user_prompt: Please select the single project from this shortlist of 20 that best matches Fatima Sarah Khalid values and scoring criteria. State your winner clearly and explain your reasoning in 3-4 sentences.
raw_response: My winner is **Decidim — Free/libre open source platform for citizen participation**. Decidim aligns closely with my values by providing a genuinely open source platform for civic infrastructure, with a strong focus on community governance and international deployment. It serves government and public sector needs, building a public digital commons, and demonstrates a commitment to openness, transparency, and accountability. As a cooperative governance model, Decidim also ensures that the project is community-driven and not controlled by a single vendor, which resonates with my preference for community-driven governance.
